name: dogtorscat.com
body: Every internal link that was opened answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But HSTS is not sent.
lesson: Send Strict-Transport-Security with a max-age of at least a year, so browsers never try plain http again.
summary: dogtorscat.com scores 54 out of 100 (F). 8 checks fail now, 36 are at risk, and 31 pass. Fix first: SPF needs more than 10 DNS lookups, so it fails everywhere.

fix.title: SPF needs more than 10 DNS lookups, so it fails everywhere
fix.evidence: dogtorscat.com's SPF record needs 14 DNS lookups, counting every include, a, mx, ptr, exists and redirect inside each include. Receivers stop at 10 and treat SPF as an error (permerror), so mail from the domain fails SPF and passes DMARC only when DKIM signs…
fix.fix: Bring it to 10 or fewer, starting with what costs the most: include:spf.web-hosting.com (7 lookups), include:zoho.com (5 lookups) and a (1 lookup). Remove includes for services that no longer send for you, replace a…

fix.title: HSTS is not sent
fix.evidence: strict-transport-security was absent on the start page. Missing on all 12 pages analyzed. A first visit over http can be intercepted.

fix.title: A lookalike of your domain looks like phishing
fix.evidence: dogtorscat.io (asks for a password), dogtorcat.com (has a website, registered 2020-08-30). Of 385 misspellings and lookalikes of dogtorscat.com checked, 2 are registered with a website or a mail server. Some may belong to unrelated owners with a similar name.
fix.fix: Check who owns each one. Report any that copy your site, ask for passwords or send mail in your name to their registrar and host (their abuse contacts are in RDAP) and to Google Safe Browsing. Register the closest…

fix.title: All touch targets must be 24px large, or leave sufficient space
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 15 elements on /, /especialidades/, /peluqueria-y-pet-shop/, for example a[href="tel:+59322812612"] and .xl\:gap-2\.5.lg\:gap-1.gap-3:nth-child(2) > .space-y-1\.5.lg\:text-left.text-center > .block[rel="noopener noreferrer"]. Impact:…
fix.fix: Make tap targets at least 24 by 24 px, or leave that much space around them.

fix.title: Elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 46 elements on /, /especialidades/, /peluqueria-y-pet-shop/, for example .btn-primary and .px-6\.5. Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Darken the text or lighten the background until normal text reaches 4.5:1 and large text 3:1.

fix.title: Other sites can frame the page
fix.evidence: Neither X-Frame-Options nor CSP frame-ancestors was sent, so the page can be framed for clickjacking. Missing on all 12 pages analyzed.
fix.fix: Send Content-Security-Policy: frame-ancestors 'self' (and X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN for old browsers).

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
Every image has an alt attribute
Nothing on the page blocks the back/forward cache
A sitemap answers with valid URLs
